subject: expr: Execute checkOrInit before constant folding (#62320)
summary: Moves ScalarFunction check/init callback execution to occur before FoldConstant so initialization/validation cannot be skipped when folding returns a Constant (including deferred-constant cases), and narrows the callback type to return *ScalarFunction; updates GROUPING metadata init closures in planner/tests accordingly. No Blocker/High issues found; later history up to upstream/master shows no follow-up fix to this change.
